description: Paid (price: see tabularium_menu). Use to check that the ledger is complete and honest: compares the receipts tabularium_pay wrote with the USDC payments your wallet actually settled on-chain over the last `days` (default 3, at most 30). Reports purchases with no receipt, receipts with no matching settlement, and receipts whose amount, payee or transaction differ from the chain. Payments to Tabularium itself (writes, reads, exports) are counted separately, since they carry no receipt by design. Reads the chain through a public Base node (TABULARIUM_RPC_URL to use your own); a 30-day check can take a minute.
name: tabularium_reconcile
title: Check receipts against the chain
